digest.component_or_area: plan review criteria vocabulary and gate framework
propositions: The rebar plan vocabulary carries two headings (Success Criteria and Acceptance Criteria) for a single concept, but all gates apply one bar to the union without semantic distinction, making the split vestigial
Criteria under ## Success Criteria are written as plain bullets and not counted by _count_ac_items, cannot carry [operator-attested] tags, and are not individually checkable, creating compliance gaps

Migrate all 106+ store tickets from ## Success Criteria headings to ## Acceptance Criteria checkboxes, update all detector regexes and reviewer prompts, and regenerate the criteria guide under unified vocabulary

The migration must preserve excluded files carrying legitimate SC vocabulary: plan_review_T2.md (trial metrics), plan_review_verifier.md and _agentic.md (dod_uncertifiable), llm/completion.py, and O-RAN-SC references

Five children stories implement heading detection, criteria routing, eval specs, author guides, and store migration with defined dependencies and sequenced expand-contract to avoid unreviewed-ticket windows
